entry.title: I benchmarked Dragonfly vs Redis vs Valkey. First, let me show you how I kept it honest.
entry.content: Part 1 of a series. This post has no throughput charts — on purpose. Before I show you a single number, I want to show you the traps that make most in-memory benchmarks lie, and exactly how I disarmed each one. If the method isn't fair, the numbers aren't worth reading.
